import pyautogui
import time
pyautogui.FAILSAFE = False

# Click on the address bar
pyautogui.click(x=900, y=89)
time.sleep(0.5)

# Select all and clear
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'a')
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.press('delete')
time.sleep(0.2)

# Type the URL with filters
url = 'https://www.cars.com/shopping/results/?fuel_slugs[]=electric&list_price_max=50000&maximum_distance=50&zip=10001&stock_type=used'
pyautogui.typewrite(url, interval=0.01)
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.press('enter')
print("Navigation triggered")
EOF
sleep 5 && export DISPLAY=:0 && gnome-screenshot -f /tmp/screenshots/results.png && echo done
